route_abort.use_when: Post-claim validation rejects a stale or contract-incompatible allocator route before substantive job mutation, or an equivalent routing abort leaves the job acceptance criteria unresolved.
route_abort.must_not_mean: The job itself is complete or has no remaining action.

no_action_needed.use_when: Durable evidence establishes that the job itself is genuinely closed and no further action is needed for its acceptance criteria.
must_not_use_for: post-claim scope rejection where job acceptance remains unmet

historical_reconciliation.rule: A reconciliation may change projection/terminal effect only; it never rewrites the historical return bytes or grants execution authority.

authority_boundary: Outcome semantics affect control-plane projection and allocation eligibility only. They do not promote Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority.
